card.name: Economics and digital-divide citations
card.fires_on: Marks inside economics and digital-divide text: reference-list entries (years, commas after years, authors) and GDP or water-energy passages. It responds to punctuation, digits and small words in them, not to one fixed word.

modes.label: Reference-list years and punctuation
modes.description: Digits or commas in the year of a citation in a bibliography about the digital divide.
modes.example: Dewan S., Riggins F.J. (2005<<),>> The digital divide: current and future research

modes.label: Metro GDP growth passage
modes.description: Commas, periods and linking words in text about metro GDP per capita growth over time.
